# Avada Commerce

> ROI-focused Shopify apps and ecommerce tools designed to optimize conversion, customer retention, and store profitability.

Avada Commerce develops a suite of Shopify applications including SEO optimization, loyalty programs, and AI-powered chatbots. The company operates globally with offices in Hanoi, Vietnam and Delaware, USA, serving ecommerce merchants seeking data-driven growth solutions.
